title: Super VRUN music test (WideMess)
description: A spinoff MUSIC TEST player (modelled on CTW NES's AudioPlayer): the game's real sound driver, every music track of Super VRUN, one extra FL TEST slot (12: a song from an FL Studio project, BrokenDev/tools/music/flp/musictest/build-supervrun-wms-mt.ps1; a placeholder song here), looping, per-channel mute/solo from the pad with the channel state on screen, song number and name on screen. A separate build target: the game build is byte-identical.

toolchain: PVSnesLib 4.6.0 in C:\BrokenNes-tools\supervrun\snes-stub	oolchain\pvsneslib (816-tcc, 816-opt, wla-65816, wlalink, smconv)

steps.name: build
steps.note: musictest/build-musictest.sh: smconv of the game's 12 modules + fltest (musictest/fltest_placeholder.it), musictest/musictest.c, tools/spcpatch.py then musictest/mtpatch.py (the mute mask: player only).

run.note: Up/Down song, A or Start play, B stop, Left/Right channel, X mute, Y solo, Select every channel on.

memory.what: Up then A started the FL TEST slot (row 12)

scenarios.why: the list draws, THINK plays at power-on, the pad reaches the FL TEST slot
